'''Syclos''', also known as '''Syclos the Lame''', was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] wizard and the alleged author of a [[Grimoire of Syclos the Lame|Grimoire]] that came to be held with great reverence on [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. The book contained what the Weikians considered to be mad ravings and was little studied by the sages of the world, as it was nigh-indecipherable. While the book was marked by the symbol of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Syclos' affiliation with the Jedi was lost to history.<ref name="NoP" />
